findings.summary: Fallback admission does not apply the Claude sandbox rules that preflight uses. With instructions.sandbox set to require, a codex executor that hits a quota is switched to the catalog claude-code executor and started with Bash and no --settings when that CLI's --help does not list --settings. Preflight of the same route raises SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE.
findings.action: fixed: _admit applies the preflight sandbox rule (_claude_sandbox_problem); test_a_fallback_must_pass_the_sandbox_rule_the_preflight_applies

findings.summary: An account gate written when the executor hits a quota does not stop a later role in the same piece. Routes are chosen once, before that gate exists, and _role starts item.routes[role] with no gates.blocked check. The reviewer pinned to claude-code still runs after the executor has gated claude-code and moved to codex.
findings.action: fixed: a role checks the gates again at its start (_start_route): fallback, wait if the gate ends within provider_wait_max_s, else PROVIDER_QUOTA; two tests

findings.summary: A fallback stored in routes.json is dropped on resume. Resume always calls _routes again from the run options. routes.json is written on fallback and never read back. A quota with an unknown reset writes no gate, so the resumed piece starts the exhausted provider again and, with the retry budget already spent, stops ROLE_FAILED.
findings.action: fixed: a taken fallback is kept in item.state.route_overrides and used by _selected on resume; test_a_fallback_taken_by_a_role_survives_a_resume

findings.summary: Dry-run reports a gated context scout as available. _selected returns the gated scout route when it has no fallback, and the preview's availability map is only route_problem, which does not read the capacity gate. The real run skips that scout.
findings.action: fixed: route_problem knows the gates, so dry-run available is false for a gated scout; test

findings.summary: PROVIDER_WAIT is not a status beacon. progress.BEACONS is still only STAGE_SLOW, STAGE_IDLE, CHECK_SLOW, BUDGET_OVER and LIMIT_OVER, so conduct.py status does not show a provider wait as the beacon of the running step. The new docs row lists PROVIDER_WAIT under the sentence that status shows the latest beacon of the running step.
findings.action: fixed: PROVIDER_WAIT, ROUTE_FALLBACK, CAPACITY_GATED added to progress.BEACONS; test
